messages:
maya: Heads-up — after rolling the AWQ (group_size=128, act_quant=3) build to staging yesterday we started seeing stream drops on long generations (~>512 tokens). First noticed on the summarization job.

sanjay: Saw the same on the chat-test harness, but only for models with >4k context. Short completions fine.

liam: Logs show a sequence of repeated `kv_cache` grow events then `worker-3 OOM` around the time the stream drops. Pasting snippet: 
```
[2026-03-18T14:12:03Z] INFO infer: allocating kv_cache new_size=112MB
[2026-03-18T14:12:03Z] WARN infer: kv_cache_realloc took 24ms
[2026-03-18T14:12:03Z] ERROR worker-3: OOM while writing kv cache
```

eva: Quick hypothesis: AWQ per-group dequant rounding plus act_quant=3 is producing occasional outlier activations that blow up attention softmax, leading to runaway KV sizes? Not sure.

ben: Interesting — on perf tests we saw that group_size=128 reduced perplexity delta vs fp16, but act_quant=3 had a few tails. Did we try group_size=64 + act_quant=4?

maya: Not in prod. We ran grid on offline eval: group_size 32/64/128 vs act_quant 2/3/4. On LAMBADA/PIQA we saw small gains at 64/4, but 64/4 increased inference latency ~5%. The failing runs are specifically 128/3.

liam: Repro snippet to trigger: 
```bash
python run_stream.py --model redwood-13b-awq --group-size 128 --act-quant 3 --max-tokens 1024 --stream true
```
It reliably drops after ~520-700 tokens in staging.

infra-bot: deploy finished for redwood-13b-awq@canary (build awq-2026-03-17-2) :white_check_mark:

sanjay: Stack traces show attention softmax values exceeding 1e6 before clamping, then NaNs in next head. Could be quantization scale mismatch on act blocks.

maya: I captured raw activations for the failing trace. There are spikes in the pre-softmax logits of head 7 around token 498. Will upload dump to s3 (s3://redwood-debug/awq/dumps/1771504321/).

eva: Two quick experiments we should run: 1) disable act quantization (act_quant=0/none) keeping group_size 128 to see if this eliminates the instability, 2) reduce group_size to 32 with act_quant=3 to see if grouping resolution helps.

ben: Also worth toggling per-channel scales vs per-group symmetric scales — our AWQ write has a switch `--per-channel-scale`. In past AWQ builds, per-channel reduced outlier compression artifacts.

liam: I'm going to try a patch that clamps softmax inputs at training-time scaling thresholds as a temporary mitigation. Patch in staging now.

maya: FYI the production fallback policy should failover to the fp16 variant when worker restarts exceed 3 in 60s. That didn't trigger because process didn't crash — stream just stopped returning tokens. We need a liveness check for streaming endpoints.

infra-bot: canary rollback scheduled for redwood-13b-awq@canary in 30m unless marked acked by @maya :alarm_clock:

maya: Marking acked. We'll run the two experiments and post results. Please don't rollback yet.

sanjay: Quick eval numbers from local grid (toy set): 
- group_size=128, act_quant=3: EM_delta LAMBADA = -3.1%, failures on long stream
- group_size=64, act_quant=4: EM_delta = -1.0%, no stream drop (small perf hit)
- group_size=128, act_quant=0 (disable act quant): EM_delta = -4.0% but stable streaming

eva: So disabling act quant seems to avoid the runtime instability but hurts quality. We need a middle ground. Maybe act_quant=2 with group_size=64?

ben: Also consider enabling KV-sharding across workers earlier in the pipeline to avoid per-worker cache growth. That reduces single-worker memory pressure but adds network hops. Tradeoff.

liam: I pushed a debug build with `--act-quant=2 --group-size=64 --per-channel-scale` to staging (tag awq-debug-177150). Running blends now.

maya: Can everyone run the streaming harness against awq-debug-177150 and report if you still see token drops? Use the same long prompts we used earlier (file in s3).

sanjay: Running now. Will report in ~10m.

liam: Note to self: add a metric for 'stream-heartbeat' where each token flush emits a heartbeat; if no heartbeat for >5s, mark stream unhealthy and attempt soft-fallback to fp16.

eva: If experiments show act_quant=2+gsize=64 is stable with acceptable EM loss, propose we add that as a secondary variant in routing (prefer awq-128-3 for cost but fallback to awq-64-2 for long streams).

maya: Agreement on action items: 
- sanjay/run streaming harness on awq-debug-177150 (in 10m)
- liam add stream-heartbeat metric + quick clamp mitigation
- ben benchmark per-channel vs per-group at scale
- eva run evals on full LLM-bench suite with awq-64-2
I'll update the ticket with results.

sanjay: awq-debug-177150 streamed full 1024 tokens without drop for 3 runs. No NaNs.

maya: Great. If repeatable, we should promote awq-64-2 as the long-context fallback and keep awq-128-3 for short requests. I'll open rollout PR for routing policy.

ben: Thx all. Leaving notes for docs/ops on the fallback policy and add the heartbeat metric as required for streaming variants. :memo:
